content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-68. - Discounts and commissions restricted generally.
content.summary:
No discount (except as herein otherwise provided expressly or by necessary implication)
               or commission shall be allowed or be paid on or for any bond sale to any purchaser
               or bidder directly or indirectly.
(Code 1981, § 27-69; Ord. No. 551, § 25(D), 5-14-1964)
